title: KS-576: build the bulk re-key as an admin-run endpoint (Peter's ask), or as Stuart's grant-driven re-key where S executes?
bluf: KS-576 says it 'must not ship before KS-577 (revoke-on-rotate)' and puts key delivery for N keys out of scope ('one response body carrying N live secrets is not the answer'; ticket text). KS-577 is In Review; the code part merged in the kintsugi deploy b1fb543640e7 but the cutover shape with Stuart is not recorded (KS-577 comment f005c7f6, 2026-11-03). Stuart proposed a grant-driven alternative so plaintext keys never leave the two systems (KS-576 comment 033cf92e, 2026-09-02) and filed PS-740 for S's half (comment eda75bbe). The approval question sits on KS-582 [Decision] (Todo, Medium; no ruling in its 2 comments). Admin-run: ticket sizes the loop at 1-2 days; grant-driven size UNMEASURED.

options.label: Grant-driven: admin mints a time-boxed grant, S re-keys itself (Stuart's proposal)
options.detail: Wednesday tells the board seat to size it as the design for KS-576 and KS-582; Stuart's PS-740 is its S half. No build before the design returns to you.

options.label: Admin-run bulk endpoint as ticket-scoped; key delivery designed separately
options.detail: The board seat builds it after KS-577 closes. Peter or an admin still moves N keys by hand.

options.label: Hold: no re-key build until KS-577 closes and Stuart's cutover is recorded
options.detail: Nothing starts. The 'one admin action' request from Peter stays unmet.

default_action: After 48 h: c. Nothing is built; KS-576 stays held behind KS-577. Wednesday re-asks you.
